test_cases.title: Home page shows the heading and the five sections in order
acs: DERIVED: /Home.aspx shows h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing and the h2 sections Important, Orders, Schemes, Results, Accounts in that order - app/ProficiencyTestingExternalWeb/Home.aspx (route /Home.aspx)
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active, so the user is already signed in when the site opens.
Section order data: 1 Important; 2 Orders; 3 Schemes; 4 Results; 5 Accounts.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The home page loads and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the page.
steps.expected: The h1 reads VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

steps.action: Read the first section heading (h2) on the page.
steps.expected: The first h2 reads Important.

steps.action: Read the second and third section headings (h2) on the page.
steps.expected: The second h2 reads Orders and the third h2 reads Schemes.

steps.action: Read the fourth and fifth section headings (h2) on the page.
steps.expected: The fourth h2 reads Results and the fifth h2 reads Accounts.

test_cases.title: Home page shows the nine action cards
acs: DERIVED: /Home.aspx shows nine cards (h3) for the order, scheme, result, report, comment and account actions - app/ProficiencyTestingExternalWeb/Home.aspx (route /Home.aspx)
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active, so the user is already signed in when the site opens.
Only the presence of each card is checked. The card destinations for orders, schemes, results, reports and comments return HTTP 500 locally (data blocker ENV-002) and are not followed.
Card data: Create order for current year; Create order for next year; View schemes; Enter results; View results; View reports; Enter comments; Edit customer details; Edit participant details.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Look at the cards under the Orders section.
steps.expected: The cards Create order for current year and Create order for next year are visible.

steps.action: Look at the cards under the Schemes section.
steps.expected: The card View schemes is visible.

steps.action: Look at the cards under the Results section.
steps.expected: The cards Enter results, View results, View reports and Enter comments are visible.

steps.action: Look at the cards under the Accounts section.
steps.expected: The cards Edit customer details and Edit participant details are visible.

steps.action: Count the cards shown on the page.
steps.expected: Nine cards are shown and the h1 is still VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

test_cases.title: Header shows the signed-in user name and the header links
acs: DERIVED: The header shows Logged in as : followed by the user name and the links APHA Science Services, User Manual, My account and a Log out button - app/ProficiencyTestingExternalWeb/NavigationBar.ascx (route /Home.aspx)
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active; the user name shown is Local Debug User.
The Log out button is checked for presence only and is not selected.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the logged-in label in the header.
steps.expected: The label Logged in as : is visible followed by the name Local Debug User.

steps.action: Look for the APHA Science Services link in the header.
steps.expected: The APHA Science Services link is visible.

steps.action: Look for the User Manual link in the header.
steps.expected: The User Manual link is visible.

steps.action: Look for the My account link in the header.
steps.expected: The My account link is visible.

steps.action: Look for the Log out button in the header without selecting it.
steps.expected: The Log out button is visible and the user is still on /Home.aspx.

test_cases.title: View Information link opens the Information page
acs: DERIVED: The View Information link on the home page opens /ViewInformation.aspx with h1 Information - route /Home.aspx to /ViewInformation.aspx
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active, so the user is already signed in when the site opens.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

steps.action: Look for the View Information link on the home page.
steps.expected: The View Information link is visible.

steps.action: Click the View Information link.
steps.expected: The browser navigates to the address path /ViewInformation.aspx.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the page that opened.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Information.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown and the h1 is still Information.

test_cases.title: My account link opens the My account page
acs: DERIVED: The My account link posts back and opens /EditParticipantDetails.aspx with h1 My account - route /Home.aspx to /EditParticipantDetails.aspx
assumptions: The local debug sign-in bypass is active, so the user is already signed in when the site opens.
The My account page is only opened and read. No field is changed and nothing is saved.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
steps.expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

steps.action: Click the My account link in the header.
steps.expected: The browser navigates to the address path /EditParticipantDetails.aspx.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the page that opened.
steps.expected: The h1 reads My account.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.

steps.action: Leave the page without changing or saving anything.
steps.expected: No confirmation or saved message is shown and the h1 is still My account.
